verdict.rationale: Running a desktop OS and developer tooling on low-cost single-board computers is a fair question for an operating system, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions single-board computers or low-cost boards. Hardware references cover only 2-in-1s, laptops, gaming PCs and high-performance power-user machines, so there is no documented support.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get a full desktop developer experience running on low-cost single-board computers
